frozen.title: Session is closed
frozen.description: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody was recorded} one {# person was recorded} other {# people were recorded}}. Nobody can be added any more. Individual entries can still be corrected — only with a reason, and logged separately.

closeDialog.description: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody is checked in} one {# person is checked in} other {# people are checked in}}. After closing, no late entries, corrections or removals are possible. This cannot be undone.

correctDialog.title: Correct {name}
correctDialog.description: Every change is recorded in the audit trail together with your reason.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}
removeDialog.description: The entry leaves the list but stays traceable in the audit trail, with your reason.
removeDialog.descriptionClosed: This session is already closed. The change is logged separately as an amendment — with your name, the time, and this reason.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this session?
deleteDialog.description: Only possible while nobody is checked in. The deletion is recorded in the audit trail.

form.description: A session is the window during which people can check in. It defaults to now until end of day — for the spontaneous case.

hints.supervisor: Who supervises the session. For ticked-off check-ins this person is the proof.

errors.conflict: Not possible — the session is closed or the person is already recorded.
